mapper.select: select from grid_message_info where grid_code = #{gridCode} order by update_time desc limit 1

select a.anchor_name ,a.address_desc,d.bank_agency_name as branchBank ,d.duty_name,d.duty_phone from performance_customer_info p left join anchor_point a on p.customer_name = a.anchor_name left join sys_dept d on p.customer_name = d.dept_name left join pa_addr_info_type e on a.belong_grid = e.code left join grid_message_info g on e.code = g.grid_code where e.ancestor_codes like concat('%,',#{gridCode},',%') and ( case when g.duty_network_name is not null then g.duty_network_name != a.anchor_name else true end )
select from grid_message_info gmi left join pa_addr_info_type p on gmi.grid_code = p.belong_grid_code where addr_level=4 and grid_code = #{gridCode}
